rundown: Lakers beat Clippers 124-110 at Acrisure Arena in Palm Springs, CA in front of 2,758. Lakers led 72-53 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Lakers won it 34-23.
Leading the way — Clippers: Nick Martinelli 22 pts; Jason Preston 5 ast; Nate Mensah 9 reb. Lakers: Chris Manon 32 pts, 13 reb; Jahmir Young 7 ast.
Where Lakers won it: they shot 31% from three to 27% and won the boards 49-30.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 9, 9:55 PM ET. It had Clippers 26% and Lakers 74%, projecting Clippers 110.1 – Lakers 117.8 (227.9 total, Lakers by 7.7).

Final: Clippers 110 – Lakers 124. Right winner: it had Lakers at 74%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Clippers came in with a 13% above average attack and a 13% leakier than average defense (1-0, 129 scored and 126 allowed a game over 1 games), worth about 13 and 13 games of evidence. Projected to score 110.1, they scored 110 (−0.1 points, 0% under); projected to allow 117.8, they allowed 124 (+6.2 points, 5% over).

Lakers came in with a 14% above average attack and a 10% leakier than average defense (1-0, 104 scored and 98 allowed a game over 1 games), worth about 13 and 13 games of evidence. Projected to score 117.8, they scored 124 (+6.2 points, 5% over); projected to allow 110.1, they allowed 110 (−0.1 points, 0% under).

The bigger miss was Lakers' scoring (+6.2 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 234 against 227.9 projected (+6.1), about the 65th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Lakers by 14 against Lakers by 7.7 projected, about the 70th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.027 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +6.3 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Hoops+ learning switches on at 20 graded games (17 so far).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
